entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Support' to be routed.
Connecting you to a support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return a pair of cycling shoes. Can you send me a label?
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can I get your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
It's sam.jones@email.com. Just let me know yes or no, I'm a bit short on time.
Of course. Pulling that up now, Mr. Jones... Okay, I see your order for the Pro-Carbon cycling shoes, delivered on December 12th. What specifically is the issue with them?
They're giving me awful blisters on my heels. I've tried adjusting the cleats a dozen times, but the fit is just wrong. I want a refund.
I'm sorry to hear that, getting blisters is the worst. Thank you for clarifying. Let me just check the policy for you... one moment.
Okay, I've reviewed your account. Your purchase is well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you.
Great. So you'll email me a shipping label?

Yes. And I see you're a VIP member with us, Mr. Jones. As a thank you for your loyalty, I've set it up so your full refund will be processed as soon as the return package gets its first scan by the carrier, rather than waiting for it to arrive at our warehouse. Does that work for you?
Yes, that's perfect. Much faster. Thank you.
You're very welcome. The email with the return label is on its way to you now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
